title: Parked conflicting record
description: One incoming causal record parked because its identifier names different content locally, stored as the blob a refs/vcs-lab/quarantine/<source lineage>/<record id> ref points at (shared-local; src/quarantine.js; ADR-0030).

recordId.description: The identifier both copies claim; it is also the last component of the ref.

digest.description: Digest of {attachment, record} for the parked copy, as the metadata snapshot computes it.

sourceLineage.description: Lineage identity of the repository the record came from; it is also the second-to-last component of the ref.

envelopeHash.description: manifestHash of the metadata envelope this copy arrived in.

record.description: The incoming record verbatim. It is never interpreted as a fact while it is parked; only a replace-local disposition puts it into service.

disputedLocalDigests.description: The local digests this copy disputed at the moment it was parked. A record of what the disagreement was, not a live value: the local side may since have changed.
